config.title: Bank Conditions Diffusion Index
config.subtitle: Is the environment good for banks, and specifically for KRE relative to small caps (IWM), which is what the backtests target? 30 scored real-time inputs across the curve and policy path, rate shock, H.8 balance sheets, financial conditions, credit spreads, equity relative performance and deposit competition & funding, each scored favorable / neutral / unfavorable by a fixed rule; 11 lagging inputs are shown as context only.
methodology: Scoring: each component is +1 (favorable), 0 (neutral) or -1 (unfavorable) by the rule shown in the table. Diffusion = 100 x (favorable + 0.5 x neutral) / components scored. Above 60 = Supportive, 40-60 = Neutral, below 40 = Challenging. Category subscores use the same formula within each category.

Context-only inputs (Oct 14, 2026): 11 components whose pre-2019 correlation with KRE's forward 26-week return vs IWM was below -0.10 (SLOOS C&I and CRE standards and demand, initial claims, all-loan charge-offs and delinquencies, CRE charge-offs, delinquencies and prices, Fed emergency lending) are still shown but no longer scored: bad readings tended to arrive after the stock move. Selection used only 2012-2018 data. CRE stress is now entirely context; Credit is scored on the 4 ICE BofA spread inputs, which start in Oct 2023 / Oct 2024 on FRED.

History is rebuilt weekly from Jan 2012. Real-time: H.8 inputs (from Aug 2012), NFCI, initial claims and charge-off / delinquency rates use ALFRED vintages, i.e. the data as published the day before each weekly date; borrowings vs deposits uses vintages from Aug 2019 and STLFSI4 from Nov 2022 (earlier weeks fall back to today's revised data, as ALFRED has no earlier vintages). Vintages are cached in data/alfred-vintages.json.gz; each refresh adds only new weeks. Still on revised / approximate data: the earlier weeks above, FDIC CD and MMDA rates and unrealized securities losses (dated ~50-60 days after period end), SLOOS (not revised) and estimated release lags for quarterly series. The latest point uses all data available now. The number of scored components changes over time (SOFR from 2018, FDIC CD rates from 2021, OAS from 2024), so early history is less comparable.

Percentile rules rank the latest value against that series' own trailing 5 years (at least 1 year required), so they measure conditions relative to recent history, not absolute levels. ICE BofA OAS history on FRED begins Oct 2023, so the HY and BBB level percentiles use the shorter window available and start scoring Oct 2024.

H.8 acceleration = 13-week annualized growth minus 52-week growth, seasonally adjusted, domestically chartered banks (small = outside the top 25). Equity components use Yahoo Finance dividend-adjusted closes; during market hours the latest bar is intraday.

Rate shock (added Oct 13, 2026): 10Y and 2Y Treasury 12-month change (≥ +75bp unfavorable, −50 to +25bp favorable, a larger fall neutral because it usually signals a growth scare) and FDIC unrealized securities gains/losses on AFS + HTM as % of equity (all insured banks: level ≥ −2% favorable, ≤ −8% unfavorable; community banks: 4-quarter change ≥ 0 favorable, ≤ −3pp unfavorable), dated ~60 days after quarter end. Alternative weightings (equal by category, overweighting Credit / Curve / Rate shock, a lean three-category composite, and weights fitted pre-2019) were tested against equal weight by component; none beat it consistently out of sample, so components stay equally weighted.

Policy path is a PROXY, not futures: (1-year Treasury CMT minus effective fed funds) / 25bp approximates net hikes (+) or cuts (-) priced over 12 months; it also contains term premium. Free, reliably scriptable SOFR / fed funds futures data (CME FedWatch) was not available. 10Y pace-of-change components score the size of the move in either direction.

Stale or failed components are shown but excluded from the score; nothing is filled in or estimated. A component is stale if its source failed this refresh or its latest observation is older than its freshness limit (daily 7 days, weekly 21, monthly 80, quarterly 240, plus the publication lag).

Sources: FRED (Federal Reserve H.8, H.15 and H.4.1, SOFR, Chicago Fed NFCI, St. Louis Fed STLFSI4, CBOE VIX, ICE BofA OAS, Fed SLOOS, DOL claims, Fed charge-off and delinquency rates incl. CRE, Fed Z.1 commercial real estate price index, FDIC national CD and MMDA rates; DGS2); FDIC BankFind financials API (unrealized securities gains/losses, equity); Yahoo Finance (KRE, XLF, IWM, SPY and the ICE BofA MOVE index, ^MOVE).

KRE charts and signal check: weekly KRE and IWM dividend-adjusted closes (Yahoo Finance) sampled on the index dates. The signal table is in-sample, uses overlapping forward windows, and carries the same lookahead caveat as the history; it is a sanity check, not a backtest.

notes.deterioration: Recomputed each refresh on the real-time history. 26-week forward averages, 2012-2026, overlapping windows: only the 15+ point bucket stands out (KRE about -4.4% vs IWM, -13.3% max drawdown). With fewer, faster-moving scored inputs the index now crosses -20 about 25 times since 2012, so read it as context, not a trigger. The real-time rebuild changed these numbers only slightly versus revised data. Few independent episodes (about 5 real stress periods); in-sample.
notes.flag: Threshold fixed on 2012-2018 data; 2019+ is out-of-sample. It uses the full Credit subscore (including context-only inputs). The 2019+ result leans heavily on 2022-23 and the flag flickers on and off, so treat it as context. Overlapping 26-week windows: about 15 independent half-years since 2019.

components.name: 5Y Treasury minus SOFR
components.rule: ≥ +0.25 favorable · ≤ −0.25 unfavorable (asset yields vs overnight funding)

components.name: 2s10s Treasury slope
components.rule: ≥ +0.50 favorable · ≤ 0 (inverted) unfavorable

components.name: 3m10y Treasury slope
components.rule: ≥ +0.50 favorable · ≤ 0 (inverted) unfavorable

components.name: 10Y Treasury: 12-month change
components.rule: ≥ +75bp unfavorable · −50 to +25bp favorable · a larger fall is neutral (usually a growth scare, not a tailwind)

components.name: 2Y Treasury: 12-month change
components.rule: ≥ +75bp unfavorable · −50 to +25bp favorable · a larger fall is neutral (policy-path shock)

components.name: Unrealized securities gains (−losses), AFS + HTM, % of equity: all insured banks
components.rule: ≥ −2% favorable · ≤ −8% unfavorable (FDIC, ~60-day publication lag)

components.name: Community-bank unrealized securities gains (−losses), % of equity: 4-quarter change
components.rule: ≥ 0 favorable (improving) · ≤ −3pp unfavorable (worsening) (FDIC, ~60-day lag)

components.name: 10Y Treasury: 1-month change
components.rule: Size of 21-trading-day move, either direction: ≤ 25bp favorable · ≥ 50bp unfavorable (rate volatility hits AOCI, mortgage and deposit repricing)

components.name: 10Y Treasury: 3-month change
components.rule: Size of 63-trading-day move, either direction: ≤ 40bp favorable · ≥ 75bp unfavorable

components.name: Policy path priced, next 12 mo (PROXY: 1Y Treasury − eff. fed funds)
components.rule: PROXY, not futures: (1Y CMT − EFFR)/25bp ≈ net hikes(+)/cuts(−) priced. ≥ +2 hikes unfavorable · −4 to +0.5 favorable · otherwise neutral (≤ −4 = recession-scale cuts)

components.name: Small-bank loan growth: accel/decel
components.rule: 13-wk annualized minus 52-wk growth: ≥ +1pp accelerating (favorable) · ≤ −1pp decelerating

components.name: Domestic-bank loan growth: accel/decel
components.rule: 13-wk annualized minus 52-wk growth: ≥ +1pp favorable · ≤ −1pp unfavorable

components.name: Small-bank deposit growth: accel/decel
components.rule: 13-wk annualized minus 52-wk growth: ≥ +1pp favorable · ≤ −1pp unfavorable

components.name: Small-bank loans-to-deposits
components.rule: Percentile vs trailing 5 yrs: lowest third favorable (liquidity room to lend) · highest third unfavorable (funding strain)

components.name: Chicago Fed NFCI
components.rule: Percentile vs trailing 5 yrs: loosest third favorable · tightest third unfavorable

components.name: St. Louis Fed Financial Stress (STLFSI4)
components.rule: Percentile vs trailing 5 yrs: lowest-stress third favorable · highest third unfavorable

components.name: VIX
components.rule: Percentile vs trailing 5 yrs: lowest third favorable · highest third unfavorable

components.name: ICE BofA MOVE index (Treasury vol)
components.rule: Percentile vs trailing 5 yrs: lowest third favorable · highest third unfavorable

components.name: HY OAS level
components.rule: Percentile vs trailing window (up to 5 yrs; FRED history begins Oct 2023): tightest third favorable · widest third unfavorable

components.name: HY OAS 4-week change
components.rule: 20-trading-day change: ≤ −0.15 tightening favorable · ≥ +0.15 widening unfavorable

components.name: BBB OAS level
components.rule: Percentile vs trailing window (up to 5 yrs; FRED history begins Oct 2023): tightest third favorable · widest third unfavorable

components.name: BBB OAS 4-week change
components.rule: 20-trading-day change: ≤ −0.05 favorable · ≥ +0.05 unfavorable

components.name: SLOOS C&I standards (large/mid firms)
components.rule: Net % tightening: ≤ 0 (easing/unchanged) favorable · ≥ 10 unfavorable
components.context_reason: context only, not scored: lagged KRE in the pre-2019 test (forward correlation below -0.10); bad readings tended to arrive after the stock move

components.name: SLOOS C&I demand (large/mid firms)
components.rule: Net % reporting stronger demand: ≥ +5 favorable · ≤ −5 unfavorable

components.name: 12-mo CD (FDIC national) minus fed funds: 3-mo change
components.rule: 3-month change in CD-minus-fed-funds spread: ≤ −0.10 (deposit rates lagging policy) favorable · ≥ +0.10 (deposit pricing pressure) unfavorable

components.name: MMDA (FDIC national) minus fed funds: 3-mo change
components.rule: 3-month change in MMDA-minus-fed-funds spread: ≤ −0.10 favorable · ≥ +0.10 (rising deposit competition) unfavorable

components.name: Small-bank large time deposits, % of deposits: 13-wk change
components.rule: 13-week change in share: ≤ −0.25pp favorable · ≥ +0.25pp (mix shifting to costly CDs) unfavorable

components.name: Small-bank borrowings growth minus deposit growth (y/y)
components.rule: 52-wk borrowings growth (H.8, NSA) minus 52-wk deposit growth: ≤ 0 favorable · ≥ +10pp (wholesale funding replacing deposits) unfavorable

components.name: Fed loans to depository institutions (H.4.1)
components.rule: H.4.1 total loans (discount window primary/secondary/seasonal credit plus BTFP-type facilities when active): 4-wk rise ≥ $2bn or level ≥ $50bn unfavorable · 4-wk change ≤ +$0.5bn favorable
components.context_reason: context only, not scored: lagged KRE in the pre-2019 test (forward correlation below -0.10); bad readings tended to arrive after the stock move
